missing_evidence: Redis server latency/error metrics and connection pool saturation for the inventory dependency
candidates.statement: Redis operations on the inventory service time out (reserve_inventory DependencyUnavailable), causing inventory 503s, order read timeouts, and gateway checkout 502s at ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation, network, config) is not established.

report.explanation: Checkout POSTs return 502 after ~2s. Traces show the gateway's order call timing out, and within the same correlation IDs the inventory service's redis.reserve_inventory fails with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503/502 up to checkout. Topology confirms inventory->redis. This bounds the fault to redis timeouts on the inventory path.
